artworks.title: Fisherman on the Lakeshore [Pescatore sulla riva del lago]
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé [proof before letters]
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a shaded riverside view across the water to a bank with trees and a structure or more trees at the horizon. In the foreground, a figure is fishing by the water's edge, surrounded by trees. The horizon has a line of trees, possibly poplars. The style includes fine lines and hatches for texture and movement in the sky, water, and foliage. The color palette is mainly black and white, creating a classic and calm tone.

artworks.title: Fishing [La pesca]
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé, proof before letters
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with two small figures playing in shallow water. Tall grasses and trees frame the background, with the moon in the sky above. The artwork is an intricate etching with fine lines detailing textures in a monochrome palette of black and white. Tall grass surrounds the figures in the foreground, and a large tree with a thick trunk is in the background with moonlight shining through its branches.

artworks.title: Antwerp: Sunset [Anversa: Tramonto]
artworks.medium: aquatint and softground etching with monotype inking, proof touched with graphite and blue pencil on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a view from water level, looking over a calm expanse where multiple boats are floating. The horizon line is below the midpoint and features silhouettes of buildings and distant landmasses. The brushstrokes are soft and blurred, giving the scene a hazy, serene quality. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and black against a light background. Closest to us, the reflection of the larger boats adds depth, while in the distance, land and structures are subtly present.

artworks.title: Keeper of the Turkeys [Gardeuse de dindons]
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a lush, foliage-filled environment. She is holding a stick in her left hand, wearing a flower crown and a long, patterned dress. The background is filled with sketched branches and blooming flowers.

artworks.title: Franz Edmund Weirotter
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrée and Jonathan Bober
artworks.description: This image is an engraved portrait featuring the upper body of a person framed in an oval. The person is slightly turned to the left, with their head facing forward. They have a composed expression, with clearly depicted facial features: sharp eyes, a straight nose, and a defined mouth. Their hair is styled in curls typical of a formal portrait from the 18th century. They are dressed in a finely detailed coat with ruffles at the collar, suggesting formality. The background features foliage, a tree trunk, and leaves. A decorative banner below the portrait bears the name "Franz Edmund Weirotter" and additional text in ornate lettering. The composition is set against a plain backdrop, emphasizing the detailed engraving work on the central subject.

artworks.title: River Landscape in the Roman Campagna
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrée and Jonathan Bober
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral landscape from an elevated perspective. The horizon is above the center, featuring a sky with clouds. A hill or mountain with buildings is in the distance. The style is detailed, with precise brushstrokes outlining trees, water, and architecture. Trees and a water body are closer, leading towards the buildings. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black, gray, and off-white typical of an etched print. The scene exudes serene elegance, inviting viewers to explore the details.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of eyes, ears, a nose, and a mouth. The eyes are detailed with eyelids and eyebrows. Two ears are included, differing in levels of detail. The left side of the sheet has minimal line work, and the right side is shaded with texture, especially on the ear and profile view. Eyebrows and sideburns are visible on the drawings. The background is a textured surface resembling aged paper, with light spots and faint discoloration.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: This is a drawing of detailed human facial features. The image includes lips, noses, and eyes, each with intricate curvature and shadows to depict anatomical structure. The eyes are detailed with fine lines to create texture and dimension. The drawing is on textured paper, adding to its classical aesthetic.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a woman's head and neck in profile. The woman's head is shown with her neck and shoulders slightly visible, positioned upright and turned to the side. Her facial features are delicately drawn with a noticeable nose, closed lips, and a gentle brow. Her hair is styled in intricate curls around the face, gathered into a large bun at the back with a spiral design. She wears teardrop-shaped earrings and a draped garment near the neckline. The background is filled with diagonal lines, contrasting with the lighter page.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image depicts a head and shoulders profile of a person facing to the left. The person's classic facial features are emphasized, with a prominent nose and chin. They have an elaborate braided updo hairstyle that spirals into a large coiled knot. The person is wearing an earring and draped in a garment. The background is a textured surface with a rectangular border, all on aged paper.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of two women's profiles, each from the shoulders up. Both women face right. The woman in the foreground has distinct facial features with a straight nose, arched eyebrow, and detailed lips. Her hair is styled in curls held back by a headband or ribbon, and she wears a round earring. The second woman, slightly behind the first, has delicate facial features and hair drawn back similarly with a headband or fabric. Both women wear draped garments with visible folds around the neck and shoulders. The drawing is set against a plain background with an aged paper pattern and presented on a larger sheet with a margin.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: This drawing depicts five profiles of faces viewed from the side. The facial features are classical and idealized, with prominent noses, lips, and sharp chins. The individuals have different styles of hair, ranging from curly to wavy, some tied back, all with fine detail. The image is on a beige paper background with visible aging or foxing marks.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: This image portrays the head of an infant in profile, facing upwards. The child's face has full cheeks and a slightly open mouth. The short, curly hair frames the rounded features of the face. The infant's body is not visible beyond the shoulders. There are no visible clothing, objects, or jewelry. The background is plain with a halo-like effect of lines radiating out from the child's head. The drawing is placed at the center of a piece of paper, which shows signs of age with discoloration and spots around the edges.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image depicts two perspectives of a child's head and part of the shoulders. The first illustration shows the child's head and shoulders from the front, with their face in focus. They have cherubic features, short hair, and a small curl at the top front of the head. The second illustration shows a side profile of the same child's head and shoulder, emphasizing head shape and hair curl. The drawing is done in an etching style with fine lines and shading for detail. The background is textured, off-white paper with brown spots. No clothing or accessories are shown.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image depicts a head-and-shoulders portrait of a young boy facing slightly to the left. The boy has curly hair, rounded cheeks, and a subtle expression. He is wearing a simple garment. The background is a blank textured surface with cross-hatching around the head.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a young boy in profile. The boy is facing to the viewer's left with his gaze downward. He has short, light-colored hair and is dressed in a garment with a buttoned collar. The background is plain, and the paper shows signs of aging with light brown spots. The image is bordered by a cream-colored area.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's head and shoulders in profile view from the left side, down to the upper part of the back. The individual is in a seated or resting position, with their face turned downward. The figure has a high forehead, a pronounced nose, closed eyes, and neutral expression. The hair is styled back into a bun with loose curls. The person is draped in fabric, and there is no jewelry or objects present. The background is a blank space with signs of paper aging, such as spots and creases.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait engraving of a person's head and shoulders in profile view. The individual has a focused expression, defined facial features, and curly hair pulled back to reveal their ears. They are dressed in a simple garment with a rounded neckline. The background is plain and textured, emphasizing the detailed figure of the person. The engraving is on a slightly aged blank page with brownish spots around the margins, likely part of a book or print collection.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image depicts an etching of the upper half of a person's body, focusing on their head and shoulders. The person is facing downward, with their head slightly tilted down and eyes closed. They have shoulder-length wavy hair framing their face, with facial features including closed eyes, a nose, and curved lips. The person is wearing a draped garment around their shoulders. The background is plain paper with visible spotting and texturing. There are no visible objects or jewelry in the image.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman with her head and shoulders visible. She is turned slightly to her right, looking at the viewer with a slight smile. The woman has soft curls held back by a headband. She is wearing a cloth that appears to be part of a dress or shawl, fastened at her shoulder with visible folds and textures. The background is plain, focusing on the woman's face. The portrait is an engraving with detailed features highlighting the woman's face and clothing texture. The paper around the engraving is slightly discolored.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait showing the bust of a woman. She is positioned facing slightly to the right but looking directly at the viewer. Her facial features are delicately defined with wide-set eyes, a straight nose, and full lips. Her hair is styled in an intricate updo with curls framing her face and tied in braids at the back. She is wearing a high-collared garment richly decorated with patterns along the edges. The style of clothing reflects a historical fashion with a voluminous collar and textured fabric. The woman is adorned with earrings. The background is plain, highlighting the detailed work on her attire and her facial expression. The image is set against a cream-colored page.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a person facing forward with a slightly turned head to the right. The person has a composed expression with finely structured facial features, including narrow eyes, a straight nose, and a small mouth. The hair is styled intricately, with a large, tall headpiece adorned with a feather and ornate decoration. The person's attire is opulent, featuring an embellished high-neck collar and richly patterned fabric. Strings of pearls and various decorative elements are seen around the neck and shoulders. The background of the image is plain.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a person's bust. The figure is centered, looking straight ahead with a calm expression. They have short, curly hair, a halo, and wear a plain garment with a decorative neckline. The engraving is set on aged paper, framed by parallel lines. The text at the bottom reads "SVLCIA VERGINE ET MAR" along with "1599." There are no visible objects or jewelry, and the background is plain, emphasizing the central figure.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body and head of a man in profile. He is facing to the right, with his head turned to display his facial features. He has a long beard and slightly curly hair. His facial features include a prominent nose and a visible ear. He is wearing a loose garment that drapes over his shoulders. The background is plain, with light discoloration and spots on the paper likely due to age.
